name: Hierarchical Wavelet Transform on Omnitrees
definition: A compression strategy that transforms nodal omnitree data into wavelet coefficients to enable lossless or lossy compression via pruning and tree restructuring (downsplit).
summary: Hierarchical Wavelet Transform on Omnitrees compresses 3D volumetric data by transforming nodal data into wavelet coefficients, distinguishing itself through anisotropic refinement and explicit basis functions for superior approximation rates.
